summary: Delegations now reach your tenant as you chose them, and errors name the real groups and roles.

fixes.title: Eligible delegations are written Eligible
fixes.text: Wizards wrote group nestings as Active, which Entra ID refuses for role-assignable groups, so those delegations never arrived. They are now Eligible.
fixes.action: Use the one-click Set to Eligible fix that validation offers for any existing Active nesting of that kind.

fixes.title: New delegations get their policy at once
fixes.text: A new group's PIM for Groups policy is applied straight away. Changes to policies someone already set are still guarded.

fixes.title: Errors name the group, role and scope
fixes.text: Engine errors say which group, role and scope they concern, with a link to that scope's PIM policies in the Azure portal.

fixes.title: Engine changes in the audit trail
fixes.text: Every membership, role assignment and account change the engine makes is recorded with the real person, group, role and scope.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Run now queues engine jobs and says so, missing engine permissions turn the Home banner red, and Commit counts a fix you just staged.
